findings.summary: Every account row repeats the same tag and same yellow/orange bar, making differences hard to spot
Fee colours explained only in a legend elsewhere, so lower bars are a guess
Minus signs on fund returns look like losses, scaring the reader even on the recommended fund
Amount is a default 10,000, so the big result isn't the reader's own number
Waterfall starts from Harel/Jerusalem instead of the user's choice, confusing
Fund fee shown in % while account fee in shekels, hard to compare
Many underlined numbers look clickable with unclear effect
